notes: Ehbrecht et al. "Global patterns and climatic controls of forest structural complexity". Maps of modelled potential structural complexity and confidence intervals for the (sub-)tropical moist broadleaf forest, (sub-)tropical tree savanna and woodland, temperate broadleaf and mixed forest, temperate conifer forest, and boreal forest biome. Extent of model predictions is confined to ecoregions that were classified as forest or woodland according to Olson et al. (2001).
